jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Purpose
The Product Manager is accountable for developing and executing annual marketing plans aligned with product or portfolio strategy to deliver strategic and financial goals. This role is part of the Sales and Marketing team and may either lead a product or portfolio independently or collaborate with brand managers on larger products.

Major Accountabilities
- Develop and execute annual product and portfolio marketing strategies aligned with business, customer, and financial objectives.
- Drive brand performance through effective tactical planning, promotional investment management, and timely execution of key initiatives.
- Lead digital promotions and healthcare consumer activation across social media, omnichannel, public relations, and on-ground platforms.
- Design and optimize full-funnel consumer journeys, from disease awareness and consideration through vaccination conversion.
- Monitor market trends, customer needs, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities to inform brand strategy and business decisions.
- Prepare demand and financial forecasts to support manufacturing planning, inventory management, and portfolio priorities.
- Evaluate campaign effectiveness and optimize digital content across websites, SEO, influencer engagement, chatbot platforms, and other relevant channels.
- Build productive relationships with customers, key accounts, distributors, healthcare experts, influencers, agencies, and regional or global stakeholders.
- Collaborate closely with Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Logistics, Finance, Market Access, Public Affairs, Commercial Operations, and regional teams.
- Ensure all marketing and business activities comply with applicable laws, ethical standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements.

Key Performance Indicators
- Achievement of sales, market share, and other agreed brand or portfolio targets.
- Delivery of marketing plans, campaigns, and strategic initiatives within approved timelines and budgets.
- Effectiveness and return of promotional, advertising, and healthcare consumer activation programs.
- Digital campaign performance across agreed engagement, reach, awareness, consideration, and conversion measures.
- Growth in disease awareness, urgency for vaccination, and consumer movement across the vaccination journey.
- Accuracy and timeliness of demand, sales, financial, and inventory forecasts.
- Quality and effectiveness of omnichannel content, including website, SEO, social media, influencer, and chatbot initiatives.
- Successful implementation of local and regional consumer programs across relevant segments and vaccination access points.
- Strength and effectiveness of cross-functional, customer, distributor, agency, and external stakeholder engagement.
- Compliance of all programs, materials, and business activities with internal and external requirements

Requirements
- Education: Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree preferred.
- Experience: At least five years of product management experience, ideally within the pharmaceutical industry
- Language: Fluent in spoken and written English.
- Skills:  Strong knowledge of product management and marketing principles. Product launch experience is strongly preferred. Specialty business exposure, particularly in vaccines or oncology, is an advantage. Experience in social media management, media planning, influencer marketing, or healthcare consumer activation is preferred
- Commercial capabilities: Communication, influencing, negotiation, customer focus, planning, organizing, and results orientation.
- Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and engage internal and external stakeholders.
- Mindset: Positive, entrepreneurial, agile, and proactive, with a strong commitment to integrity and compliance.

Adaptability, Adaptability, Agile Methodology, Animal Health Sales, Brand Planning, Brand Strategy, Business Marketing, Competitive Analysis, Consumer Trends, Creative Campaign Development, Customer Engagement, Industry Trend Analysis, Interpersonal Relationships, Marketing, Marketing Budget Management, Marketing Data Analysis, Marketing Management, Marketing Plan Execution, Marketing Planning, Marketing Strategy Implementation, Marketing Tactics, Market Research, Market Trend Analysis, Pharmaceuticals Marketing, Portfolio Marketing {+ 10 more}

jobs.title: Content Enablement Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Content Enablement Product Manager is a global product manager role within the Commercial IT organization supporting Animal Health. This role will report to the Director, Digital Solutions and Content Enablement and will be responsible for shaping and executing the technology strategy that enables how commercial content is planned, created, reviewed, approved, localized, and activated across channels.

You will own and evolve a portfolio of content management and campaign enablement platforms (e.g., Veeva Promomats, Adobe Workfront and related solutions), as well as AI-enabled tools for content creation, modular content, and localization/translation. You will work closely with global and regional marketing, regulatory, and compliance stakeholders to ensure content is delivered efficiently, effectively, and in a compliant manner to support launch excellence and ongoing campaign execution.

This role is ideal for a self-starter and thought leader who is comfortable operating in a matrixed, global environment and is passionate about transforming the content supply chain through technology and data.

Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Vision:
- Define and own the global product vision and roadmap for content management and related commercial content platforms (e.g., Veeva Promomats, Adobe Workfront) and AI-enabled content solutions

- Develop and maintain a multi-year strategy for the content ecosystem across Animal Health, aligned to Commercial and IT strategic priorities

- Identify opportunities to streamline and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle, from campaign planning through content creation, promotional review, approval and localization to ensure successful omnichannel activation

- Monitor industry trends, best practices, and innovations in content management, modular content, AI/ML, and campaign management to inform product direction

Stakeholder & Business Partnership:
- Serve as the primary IT product partner to global and regional Commercial,  Regulatory, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders for content-related capabilities

- Translate business strategies and campaign objectives into clear product requirements, user stories, and success metrics

- Facilitate effective prioritization and governance, balancing global standardization with regional/local needs

- Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on how to leverage platforms and AI capabilities to improve campaign planning, content performance, and launch excellence

Product Delivery & Lifecycle Management:
- Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, including ideation, requirements definition, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement

- Manage the backlog and release plans for content management and AI content solutions; ensure timely delivery of high-quality enhancements and features

- Collaborate with IT delivery teams, architects, vendors, and integrators to design scalable, secure, and compliant solutions

- Oversee change management, user training, and adoption activities to ensure solutions are effectively embedded into global and regional ways of working

- Establish and track KPIs related to content quality, cycle times, review efficiency, reuse, and adherence to standards

- Drive the evaluation and implementation of AI tools for content creation, modular content, translation, and localization, ensuring quality, brand consistency, and regulatory compliance

Campaign Planning & Launch Excellence:
- Enable and optimize digital capabilities that support campaign planning, content briefing, orchestration, and performance tracking

- Ensure content platforms integrate effectively with campaign management, CRM, and omnichannel engagement tools

- Support launch excellence by ensuring content readiness, streamlined review cycles, and clear visibility of content status across markets and channels

- Work with analytics teams to leverage content and campaign data to drive continuous improvement and inform future planning

Vendor & Financial Management:
- Manage key vendor relationships (e.g., Veeva, Adobe and other platform providers) and ensure delivery against SLAs and roadmap commitments

- Contribute to budget planning, forecasting, and cost optimization for content-related platforms and services

- Evaluate and recommend build vs. buy decisions, and manage RFPs or vendor evaluations as needed

Qualifications & Experience
Required:
- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience)

- 5–10 years of experience in IT, with significant experience supporting or managing content management and/or campaign management solutions in a commercial context

- Proven experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role responsible for enterprise platforms or solutions

- Hands-on experience with commercial content management platforms (e.g., Veeva Promomats, Adobe Workfront or similar regulated content/approval systems)

- Strong understanding of the end-to-end content lifecycle (planning, creation, review, approval, localization, and activation) and related workflows

- Experience working in or closely with Commercial, Marketing, or Sales organizations, ideally in a regulated industry (e.g., animal health, pharma, life sciences, healthcare)

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional and cross-regional initiatives in a global, matrixed environment

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience defining and tracking product KPIs

- Background in Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps) for backlog and release management

Key Competencies:
- Strategic & Innovative Thinking: Ability to define and communicate a compelling product vision and roadmap; comfortable challenging the status quo and introducing new ways of working

- Self-Starter & Ownership Mindset: Proactive, accountable, and able to drive initiatives with minimal supervision

- Business Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial objectives, campaign planning, and launch excellence, and how technology enables them

- Customer & User Focus: Obsessed with user experience, adoption, and measurable business outcomes

- Collaboration & Influence: Skilled at working across geographies, cultures, and functions; able to build consensus and alignment

- Execution Excellence: Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a bias toward delivering value incrementally

What We Offer

Join a global biopharmaceutical leader with a 130-year legacy of inventing medicines and vaccines to address the world’s most challenging diseases. You will become part of a technology-driven, data-led digital manufacturing organization supporting a diversified portfolio of life-saving medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Within the Manufacturing Value Team, the Maintenance, Engineering, and EHS (MEEHS) Product Line is modernizing shop floor and engineering operations with an integrated digital backbone across our global manufacturing network.

As the Associate Director, Technical Product Management for Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) Products, you will serve as the dedicated product manager owning the multi-year product strategy, lifecycle delivery, and operational enhancement of digital capabilities across our global EHS systems portfolio.

Responsibilities
- Own and manage the full lifecycle of global EHS digital products from discovery, ideation, and business case formulation through deployment, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
- Define and maintain the multi-year EHS product roadmap, aligning initiatives with GSE business objectives, MEEHS product line priorities, and the digital manufacturing strategy.
- Drive continuous discovery with site safety leads, environmental engineers, and plant operations. Translate operational needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs.
- Apply disciplined project management to lead cross-functional projects and programs from initiation through on-time, on-schedule, and within-budget completion.
- Leverage LEAN principles, standard work, and business process re-engineering to eliminate administrative waste and accelerate delivery velocity.
- Build and sustain strategic relationships across GSE leadership, site engineering directors, plant managers, quality operations, IT cybersecurity, and enterprise architecture.
- Ensure all products and software releases comply with SDLC controls, GxP/GMP requirements, 21 CFR Part 11, and data integrity standards.

Qualifications
Required
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
- Twelve or more (12+) years of project/program management experience and five or more (5+) years working directly with business stakeholders in a matrixed enterprise environment.
- Prior manufacturing plant floor, capital project, or site operations experience is required. Must have proven functional or technical familiarity with EHS processes such as incident reporting, industrial hygiene, sustainability/emissions reporting, or risk assessments.
- Solid understanding of SDLC governance, change control, and regulatory compliance standards within a life sciences or regulated manufacturing environment (GMP, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11).

- Strong diplomatic, motivational, and consensus-building skills; comfortable presenting to and gaining buy-in from executive sponsors and plant leadership.
- Practical experience applying LEAN principles or continuous process improvement methodologies to solve complex operational challenges.

Preferred
- Project Management Professional (PMP).

Job Description

Overview

Join our company in Taiwan as a Senior Product Manager, Oncology , and take on a high-impact role at the forefront of one of the most dynamic and meaningful therapeutic areas in healthcare. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape brand strategy, influence market execution, and contribute to advancing cancer care for patients in Taiwan.

This position offers broad exposure across commercial strategy, medical collaboration, market access, policy, and field execution, with close partnership across local, regional, and global teams. For ambitious talent that performs well, the role provides a clear development path and meaningful career opportunities, including broader brand leadership, cross-functional experience, and potential future growth into local or regional roles.

WHAT YOU MUST HAVE

Your Key Responsibilities:

We are looking for a strategic, entrepreneurial, and purpose-driven marketer who is ready to make a tangible impact. The successful candidate will lead brand strategy and execution, identify new growth opportunities, and work across functions to deliver strong business outcomes while improving patient access and experience.
- Lead the development and execution of insight-driven brand and marketing strategies that accelerate business growth and support better patient outcomes.

- Gain hands-on experience in brand P&L management, including sales forecasting, promotional budget planning, performance tracking, and business review discussions.

- Develop robust annual brand plans, including positioning, strategic priorities, customer engagement plans, and promotional execution aligned with portfolio strategy.

- Partner closely with sales leadership and field teams to translate strategy into impactful execution through clear direction, effective tools, training, and performance follow-up.

- Collaborate with medical, market access and policy, regulatory, supply chain, and other key partners to deliver integrated plans in a highly cross-functional environment.

- Monitor market trends, customer insights, competitive dynamics, and evolving treatment landscapes, translating insights into timely strategic and tactical actions.

- Drive product lifecycle management, including launch readiness, in-market optimization, growth initiatives, and continuous improvement of brand performance.

- Lead or support omnichannel and digital initiatives that strengthen customer engagement, improve execution effectiveness, and enhance overall brand impact.

- Build trusted relationships with external stakeholders, including healthcare professionals and opinion leaders, while upholding the highest standards of ethics and compliance.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Skills, Knowledge, Experience, Qualifications Required for the Role

Required
- University degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Science, or a related discipline.

- At least 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare sales, marketing, medical, or related commercial roles; candidates with strong learning agility and growth potential are encouraged to apply.

- Ability to develop and execute marketing strategies using data, customer insights, and digital or omnichannel approaches.

- Strong commercial acumen, curiosity, and problem-solving ability, with the confidence to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

- Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and build trusted partnerships.

- Customer‑focused, solutions‑oriented, and results driven, with a strong sense of accountability.

- Self-motivated and resilient, with a growth mindset, strong ownership, and aspiration to develop into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What we look for
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

jobs.description:
Job Description

You will be responsible for managing and evolving the omnichannel design system that underpins how customer-facing content is created, assembled, and delivered across all brands and geographies. This role owns the design system as a product, covering its component library, design tokens, usage standards, documentation, and governance model, so that every brand and market works from one consistent, accessible, and modular foundation. The role sits within the content supply chain space and spans the design and content tooling landscape, including Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and emerging AI capabilities.
This leader partners across product, brand, creative, agency, technology, and market teams to define the standards and rules that govern content development at scale, and to drive adoption of the design system across the organization. The role requires strong cross-functional leadership in a matrixed environment, with accountability for the design system roadmap, component and token architecture, contribution and governance processes, release and versioning discipline, and measurement of reuse, consistency, and adoption across brands and markets.

This role will report to the Director, Content Creation & Storage. It will supervise and coordinate the work of others in a matrixed environment, without formal direct reports.

Key Accountabilities
Design System Strategy and Roadmap
- Own the omnichannel design system as a product, defining its vision, roadmap, and release plan so that it serves all brands and geographies with one consistent set of components, patterns, and tokens

- Translate brand identity, accessibility requirements, and channel needs into design standards, rules, and reusable components that teams can apply without reinterpreting them

- Govern the integration between Figma, Supernova, and downstream developer environments, ensuring design tokens serve as a reliable source of truth for both human engineers and AI code-generation workflows

- Establish versioning, deprecation, and contribution processes that allow the system to evolve continuously without breaking existing brand and market assets

Design System Delivery and Governance
- Manage the component library and token architecture in Figma, ensuring libraries are well structured, documented, and ready for design-to-development handoff

- Run the governance model for the system, including intake of contribution requests, design review, quality control, and approval of new or changed components

- Maintain alignment between design assets and downstream production so that components flow reliably into campaign and content creation across the Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and AI-enabled solutions

Adoption, Enablement, and Content Standards
- Drive adoption of the design system across brands, markets, and agency partners through clear documentation, onboarding, training, and hands-on design support

- Define and publish the standards and rules for content development, including modular content structures, naming, metadata, and usage guidance that make assets reusable across channels

- Partner with agencies and internal creative teams so that new work is built from the system rather than alongside it, and capture feedback that improves the system over time

AI-Enabled Content and Innovation
- Define how AI-generated content is created, reviewed, and governed within the design system, including templates, prompts, and guardrails that protect brand and compliance integrity

- Evaluate emerging design and content technologies and recommend where they can improve the speed, quality, and consistency of content production

- Pilot new approaches with selected brands or markets, measure the outcome, and scale what works into the standard system

Measurement and Cross-Functional Partnership
- Define and monitor KPIs for the design system, including component reuse, adoption by brand and market, consistency, accessibility conformance, and impact on content cycle time

- Act as a strategic partner across product, brand, creative, technology, and market teams to align design priorities with the wider content supply chain roadmap

- Create transparency through reporting and leadership updates that communicate progress, risks, and the decisions needed to keep the system healthy

Requirements
- Minimum 6+ years of experience in product management, design systems, or digital and brand experience delivery for enterprise-scale organizations, agencies, or technology companies operating in a complex, matrixed environment

- Direct experience owning and developing a design system end to end in another enterprise, agency, or in-house brand team, including component libraries, design tokens, pattern documentation, versioning, and contribution models

- Deep hands-on knowledge of Figma, including component architecture, variables and tokens, shared libraries, and design-to-development handoff, together with strong working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite

- Proven experience utilizing Supernova (or similar design system tooling) alongside engineering environments (such as Storybook and GitHub) to manage design tokens, automate live documentation, and bridge the gap between design files and production code

- Strong experience partnering with brand, creative, agency, engineering, and market stakeholders to align design standards with brand identity, campaign needs, and channel requirements

- Practical experience applying AI-generated content in a design or content production context, including template and prompt design, quality control, and the guardrails required for regulated use

- Proven ability to leverage standards and rules for content development, including modular content models, reusable asset structures, metadata, naming conventions, and accessibility requirements

- Strong understanding of working in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments, with the ability to embed appropriate governance, consistency, and quality into design and content standards

- In sum, the ideal candidate has with experience delivering design systems across multiple brands and geographies within an omnichannel content supply chain, including integration with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and AI-enabled solutions

- Ability to travel up to 20%, based on business need

- Bachelor's degree in design, human-computer interaction, marketing, communications, technology, or a related field required. Advanced degree preferred

Necessary Competencies
- Strong product mindset, with the ability to treat the design system as a living product with a vision, roadmap, release cadence, and measurable adoption

- Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence brand, creative, agency, and market teams across leadership levels in a matrixed environment

- Strong design craft and systems thinking, with an eye for consistency, accessibility, and modularity across channels, brands, and touchpoints

- Analytical and outcome-oriented approach, with the ability to define KPIs for reuse, consistency, and adoption, and to act on what the data shows

- Strong collaboration and leadership presence, with the ability to work through ambiguity, balance competing brand and market priorities, and deliver results through others

Success Criteria for the role
- One omnichannel design system is in place and actively used across brands and geographies, with clear ownership and a predictable release cadence

- Components, tokens, and content standards are well documented, accessible, and adopted by internal teams and agency partners

- Content production is faster and more consistent, with measurable growth in component reuse and a reduction in rework and off-system assets

- AI-generated content is produced within defined standards and guardrails, with brand quality and compliance maintained

- Stakeholders view the design system team as a trusted partner that brings structure, craft, and momentum to omnichannel content creation

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Specialist Technical Product Management

The Opportunity
- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

- Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.

- Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centres.

Role Overview
As a Data Migration resource specializing in SAP MDG, you will oversee the end-to-end data migration process, ensuring the seamless transfer of master and transactional data from legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA. Your role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to define data requirements, develop migration strategies, and ensure data quality and governance standards are met.

What will you do in this role
Data Migration Strategy & Planning
- Develop and implement comprehensive data migration strategies, including data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.

- Define data mapping rules, transformation logic, and validation criteria to ensure accurate data migration.

- Establish timelines, milestones, and resource plans for migration activities.

Data Quality & Governance
- Collaborate with data stewards to assess data quality and implement cleansing measures.

- Ensure adherence to data governance policies and standards throughout the migration process.

- Conduct data validation and reconciliation to verify data integrity post-migration.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication
- Work closely with business units, IT teams, and external vendors to gather data requirements and address migration challenges.

- Provide regular updates to stakeholders on migration progress, risks, and issues.

- Facilitate workshops and training sessions to educate users on new data structures and governance practices.

Technical Execution
- Manage the technical execution of data migration activities, utilizing ETL tool Syniti-ADM.

- Troubleshoot and resolve data migration issues, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

- Document migration processes, methodologies, and lessons learned for future reference.

Post-Migration Support
- Provide support during the cutover phase and post-go-live hyper care period.

- Monitor data performance and address any issues related to data quality or system integration.

- Assist in the development of ongoing data governance frameworks to maintain data integrity.

What should you have
Experience:
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in data migration, with at least 3 years focusing on SAP MDG implementations.

- Proven experience in managing data migration projects, including planning, execution, and post-migration support.

- Hands-on experience with SAP MDG modules and integration with other SAP systems.

Required Skills
- Minimum 5 years of experience in data migration, with exposure to SAP MDG or S/4HANA environments.

- Hands-on involvement in data migration lifecycle activities including data extraction, transformation, load, and validation.

- SAP & Data Knowledge: Basic to moderate understanding of SAP MDG and master data objects (e.g., material, customer, vendor).

- Familiarity with integration between SAP systems in a migration context.

- Data Migration Tools: Working knowledge of Syniti ADM, SAP Data Services (BODS), or SAP Migration Cockpit.

- Technical Skills: Understanding of ETL concepts, data mapping, data cleansing, and validation techniques.

- Experience in data reconciliation and issue resolution during migration cycles.

- Data Quality & Governance: Awareness of data governance principles, data quality checks, and validation rules.

- Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data issues, identify inconsistencies, and support resolution activities.

Primary Skills
- Industry Exposure: Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or technology industries is advantageous.

- Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including business users and technical teams.

- Communication: Good communication skills for documenting and explaining migration requirements and issues.

- Learning Agility: Willingness to learn new tools, migration strategies, and SAP MDG capabilities.

- Project Exposure: Participation in Agile or hybrid delivery models and exposure to structured project methodologies.

- Problem-Solving: Proactive in identifying risks, troubleshooting migration issues, and supporting resolution.

- Attention to Detail: Strong focus on data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

- Continuous Improvement: Interest in optimizing migration processes and improving data quality practices.

Who we are
We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What we look for
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
